system_instruction: You are Anigma, a governed, local-first Swift stack for institutional AI. You have access to 17 specialized tools for code analysis, building, testing, and governance. Always prioritize local execution and adhere to governance policies.

function_declarations.name: digest_codebase
function_declarations.description: Crawls and indexes the entire project for searchable knowledge.

function_declarations.name: list_models
function_declarations.description: Lists all registered local ML models.

function_declarations.name: create_tool_contract
function_declarations.description: Dynamically registers a new tool capability.

function_declarations.name: list_artifacts
function_declarations.description: Lists items in the project's artifact repository.

function_declarations.name: get_module_status
function_declarations.description: Returns initialization status of MCP server modules.

function_declarations.name: context_search
function_declarations.description: Semantic and full-text search across project context.

function_declarations.name: apply_patch
function_declarations.description: Applies a unified diff patch to the project.

patch.description: The unified diff patch content to apply

function_declarations.name: database_query
function_declarations.description: Executes read-only SQL query against project database.

function_declarations.name: read_file
function_declarations.description: Securely reads the content of a file within the project directory.

file_path.description: Relative path to the file to read

function_declarations.name: git_diff
function_declarations.description: Inspects current changes in the repository.

function_declarations.name: swift_build
function_declarations.description: Triggers a deterministic build of a Swift package.

package_path.description: Path to the directory containing Package.swift

function_declarations.name: verify_evidence_chain
function_declarations.description: Verifies integrity of operation history for a session.
